text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents original research focused on predicting future land use change (LUC) hot-spots across the entire country of Italy to the year 2100 using an ensemble of 32 simulations. It explicitly implements national-scale spatial modeling with a modified CLUE-S model (LUC@CMCC), incorporates multiple future scenarios by varying five key inputs (e.g., climate projections under A2/B2, demographic trends, protected area policies), and includes quantitative spatial outputs (mapped LUC hot-spots) evaluated at multiple administrative and biophysical scales. The methodology reports quantitative metrics such as stability factors, logistic regression coefficients, ROC/AUC validation (average accuracy 0.86), and percent area changes. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale coverage, primary focus on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatially explicit modeling with accuracy metrics, and mapped projections. None of the exclusion criteria apply.)
